summary: Test-writing run for issue #39. Committed the upstream solver parity corpus byte-identical (viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, upstream PR #112) as a test fixture and added SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the CompositionSolver fast path with exact double equality (scores, exclusions, earliest-index-wins ties, unknown/zero-weight handling), mirroring upstream corpus_test.exs. Added /api/v1 wire-contract pins to PaletteAPIClientTests so the generated OpenAPI client migration (implementation phase) is verifiable as behavior-preserving. Documented corpus consumption/refresh in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. swift test could NOT be executed: this container has no Swift toolchain (bin/lint reports 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests'); instead the identical replay logic (same canonical summation order, exact IEEE-754 doubles) was validated against the committed corpus externally with 12/12 scenarios matching and 0 failures, including all 5 tie scenarios and both null-selection scenarios.

acceptance_criteria.description: Solver parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests loading the committed corpus, asserting WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match exactly including ties

references.locator: external: exact IEEE-754 replay of all 12 scenarios mirroring Swift scorer/solver summation order (canonical white,red,green,blue,lps)

verification.note: 12 scenarios: per-candidate scores exact ('excluded' union honored), selection + selected_hex_color + error exact, tied_indices recomputed bit-for-bit, 5 tie scenarios, 2 all-excluded scenarios, zero-weight-missing and unknown-weight (ultraviolet) scenarios. 11/12 also replay through the CompositionSolver contiguous fast path (missing-target scenario is scorer-only because the app fails earlier at source-grid validation). swift test itself blocked by missing toolchain in this container.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records generated-client migration notes, /api/v1 shape changes found, parity test results

verification.note: PR is published by Paid after this phase. Parity findings for the PR body: exact agreement on all 12 scenarios; ties are earliest-index-wins and bit-identical (dyadic corpus values make cross-language summation order irrelevant); exclusion policy matches (any positive-weight channel missing on candidate or target); unknown light-source weights ignored; zero-weight channels never exclude. No /api/v1 shape changes found in the published spec vs the hand-rolled client's wire format (upstream enforces it with Schemathesis + oasdiff).
